channel.title: OpenAI Research & Releases
channel.description: Latest research papers and model releases from OpenAI

item.title: Atlassian and OpenAI expand partnership to turn enterprise knowledge into action
item.description: Atlassian and OpenAI are expanding their partnership to connect frontier models with enterprise knowledge and help teams plan, build, and deliver work.

item.title: How Jump Trading is scaling quant research with ChatGPT
item.description: Jump Trading uses OpenAI to expand quantitative research. See how longer-running AI workflows combine multiple data sources with human review.

item.title: Sharing AI progress in mathematics
item.description: OpenAI publishes new results on open problems in mathematics from an internal frontier model and shares Lean proof formalizations and research details on GitHub.

item.title: Advancing computer use with Ironclad
item.description: Learn how OpenAI and Ironclad are training and evaluating AI agents on complex contracting workflows to advance computer use for professional work.

item.title: Our approach to EU text provenance rules
item.description: How OpenAI is approaching text watermarking under EU rules. Learn where watermarks apply, how detection works, and why access starts with researchers.

item.title: Building advertising for the way people use AI
item.description: OpenAI introduces a new visual ad format in ChatGPT and expands measurement tools, attribution partnerships, and brand suitability for advertisers.

item.title: A model guide for the GPT-6 family
item.description: Learn how startups can choose GPT-6 models, tune reasoning effort, improve prompts and skills, coordinate tools, and prepare workflows for production.

item.title: Chatham scales its capital markets expertise with OpenAI
item.description: Chatham Financial uses Codex and GPT-5.6 to build technology and redesign workflows, cutting trade validation from 30 minutes to under 4.

item.title: The eternal complement
item.description: Advanced AI may matter most for the routine work behind breakthrough ideas. Explore why execution could shape the next economy and the pace of progress.

item.title: How Albertsons Companies is reimagining retail from the inside out
item.description: Albertsons Cos. is using ChatGPT Enterprise and the OpenAI API to help teams work faster and make grocery shopping easier for millions of customers.

item.title: The Den frees up 10-15 hours a week to grow with ChatGPT Work
item.description: As it opens a new location, the social club prepares grant applications in 2 hours instead of 3 days and liquor-license materials in 3 hours instead of 4 days.

item.title: Disrupting a coordinated model-distillation campaign
item.description: Learn how OpenAI disrupted a campaign to extract protected model reasoning and is strengthening defenses against adversarial distillation.

item.title: Helping small businesses put AI to work
item.description: OpenAI is partnering with America’s SBDC to expand hands-on AI training and local support for small businesses, alongside a new report on how small teams are using AI.

item.title: Introducing GPT-6.1 Sol
item.description: Meet GPT-6.1 Sol: near-Astra intelligence for coding, computer use, and professional work at one-fifth of Astra’s standard API input and output token prices.

item.title: DevDay 2026 Recap
item.description: Explore more than 20 announcements from OpenAI DevDay 2026, including GPT-6 Astra, ChatGPT, Codex, APIs, security, and new tools for builders.

item.title: Introducing dots
item.description: Dots by OpenAI are proactive assistants that can keep working across complex projects and everyday tasks. Learn how dots help you stay in control while work moves forward.

item.title: Towards safety cases for frontier AI training
item.description: Our early guidelines for safety cases in frontier AI training cover technical safeguards, operational practices, and investigating misalignment incidents

item.title: How we will do better for Australia
item.description: OpenAI apologises for incidents involving Australian government websites and outlines stronger safeguards and support to strengthen Australia’s cyber defences.

item.title: The Lenfest Institute grows landmark program with expanded OpenAI support
item.description: OpenAI is expanding the Lenfest AI Collaborative and Fellowship Program with $5 million in funding and up to $5 million in software credits and engineering support.

item.title: Basis completes a tax workbook 2x faster with GPT-6 Astra
item.description: GPT-6 Astra completed a 50-tab tax workbook twice as fast as GPT-5.6 Sol, and its stronger understanding of user intent gives Basis more confidence in real-world use.
